results.title: O River, We Forced You to Chew Up Their Crops
results.original_title: O River, We Forced You to Chew Up Their Crops
results.overview: Three intergenerational fables rooted in Nubian cosmologies confront the erasures wrought by the Aswan High Dam, tracing the rupture between people, the Nile and ancestral knowledge passed down through stories.

results.title: The Centre Cannot Hold
results.overview: Through speculative poetic narrative and tactile 16mm imagery, Corsica’s serene landscape gradually uncovers the island’s complex histories of belonging.

results.title: No Archive Can Restore this Chorus of (Diasporic) Shame
results.original_title: No Archive Can Restore this Chorus of (Diasporic) Shame
results.overview: Through animated text, layered sound recordings and reimagined protest songs from the 1947 Egba Market women’s revolt, this immersive work creates a sonic redress to colonial narratives of Nigeria.

results.title: Landscapes of Shame
results.overview: Navigating Ireland’s haunted landscapes, ecological extinction and cultural suppression emerge as intertwined forms of colonial erasure.

results.title: An Unimaginable Leap
results.overview: Through contemporary Jamaica, everyday life, celebration and respite converge in a meditation on revolutionary time, climate crisis and cinema.

results.title: A Kind of Purity
results.overview: At an art gallery, a disillusioned assistant's pretence of normality is pushed to breaking point when a sudden act takes place.

results.title: Date Night
results.overview: Danielle and Harry's latest attempt at kinky roleplay shines a discomforting light on what they really want from life.

results.title: Weed World
results.overview: After stumbling upon a Marijuana shop in the desert, two young children wonder why anybody would bother smoking it. A group of friendly characters attempt to educate them but events take a dark turn after their leader is challenged.

results.title: Cats Cradle
results.overview: A day at the beach goes awry when Chris is forced to find a new place to live.

results.title: The Last Shuttle
results.overview: With Earth nearing collapse, a hardened scavenger discovers a lost mute girl whose family may offer their only hope of escape, forcing him to choose between self-preservation and redemption.

results.title: The Enigma of Franca Farmín
results.overview: Franca Farmín, a young aspiring YouTuber obsessed with documenting paranormal phenomena, travels to the remote Laguna del Olvido, convinced she can capture the unknown on camera and uncover a mystery that could make her go viral. Franca sets out in search of a legend?and becomes one.

results.title: Manithee: the fire bird
results.overview: A brilliant female physicist fighting to introduce her breakthrough technology to the world and an ambitious young filmmaker from a small village, determined to create a world-class masterpiece, find themselves trapped in a mysterious forest. The story follows the challenges they face and how they overcome these obstacles to achieve their dreams.

results.title: Between Summers
results.overview: Between french fries, TikToks, and sunscreen, carefree moments clash with self-doubt, and playful freedom with societal pressure. This is the vibrant world of adolescents searching for their place – on the lawn and in life. When the orange slide is torn down, the chapter of childhood comes to an end. Two years later, after the renovation, it's not just the public pool that has changed.

results.title: A Light in the Darkness
results.overview: Venturing into intricate cave systems, the deep oceans, and subterranean aquifers where light barely reaches, we meet the scientists who have dedicated their lives to creatures who have evolved in perpetual darkness, working tirelessly—often in obscurity—to understand and protect ecosystems and animals most people will never know exist. Paralleling the deeply personal journey of the film's director as he confronts a terminal illness, the story becomes a reflection on what it means to face one's own darkness.

results.title: Papagayo
results.overview: A month after the Hamas attack and Israel's bloody retaliation, which marks the beginning of the genocide of Palestinians in Gaza, an Israeli illustrator living in Spain breaks up with her long-term partner, a Spanish filmmaker of Syrian origin. Omar decides to continue working on the film they had been making together, using footage shot in the Middle East and the unfinished drawings left behind by his beloved. A story about religious fanaticism and its absurdities, and a painful dissection of the relationship between two people who wanted to be together despite their cultural differences.

results.title: Cosmic Symphony
results.overview: Four iconic instruments, including The Wizard of Oz and A Star Is Born pianos, all lost in the 2025 Los Angeles Fires, are celebrated by their musicians, culminating in an animated send-off towards an imagined future, a Cosmic Symphony. Directed by Oscar-nominated composer Laura Karpman, and featuring John Clayton, Susie Chung, Starr Parodi and Diane Warren, Cosmic Symphony explores a truth that every musician knows - musical instruments have souls.

results.title: A Quiet Man
results.overview: An intimate portrait of Romain Zaleski, an industrialist, philanthropist, and art collector who for years has flown under the radar. He left home with practically nothing but today, he is France’s fourth richest person with a net worth estimated at several billion euros. The fascinating and twisted paths that led Zaleski to acquire his remarkable fortune ran through Poland, France, and Italy.

results.title: Grandmasters
results.overview: The once esoteric and uninspired world of competitive chess is thrown into turmoil when an eccentric German entrepreneur enlists reigning champion Magnus Carlsen to launch a new league that aims to revolutionize the game, challenge the sport's governing body, and "make chess cool."

results.title: The Whisper of Sunlight
results.overview: Set in Hong Kong, Wong closely observes patients and their families during their final days as they grapple with the difficult questions surrounding access to a costly experimental drug that may offer them a last hope. The film sensitively explores the vulnerability and uncertainty that accompany rare and devastating illnesses.

results.title: The Goodie Bag
results.overview: An undergrad embarks on a networking meeting with an older woman who might offer more than he signed up for.
